note: Editor toolbar buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editing actions (e.g., Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, etc.)
Editor toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view/edit modes (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, etc.)
Editor toolbar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for status or mode indicators (e.g., 'Normal', 'Insert')
Editor mode radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for cursor modes (e.g., 'Normal', 'Insert')
Editor options checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for feature toggles (e.g., 'Show Line Numbers', 'Highlight Current Line')
Editor status bar -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document status (e.g., 'Ln 1, Col 1', 'UTF-8')
